summary.text: Niles Stephens is the Republican candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 110 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Claire Heinrich.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Stephens described himself as a former Wildwood city councilman, a Republican committeeman for Wildhorse Township and managing director of MO Tax Relief Now.

paragraphs.text: Niles Stephens, in a Ballotpedia survey, described himself as a husband, father and conservative leader in west St. Louis County.

He listed his roles as managing director for MO Tax Relief Now, former Wildwood city councilman, Republican committeeman for Wildhorse Township, and an elected delegate to the 2024 Republican National Convention.
Stephens named keeping taxes low and government affordable, promoting traditional conservative family values, and providing constituent services as his three key campaign messages.

He said he would file legislation on protecting independent pharmacies, transparency and accountability for special needs students, and codifying the "Slayer Rule" so that people who kill do not benefit from their victims, and that his focus would include budgets, appropriations, taxes, local government and government efficiency.
